features Capabilities inside existing screens, with no screen of their own. Barcodes Plan Barcode field, generation, label printing and sale scanning. Stored barcodes are kept while off. Product Variants Sell one product in several sizes or colours, each with its own stock, barcode and price. A group counts as one product on the plan. Free, off by default. Existing groups keep selling while off. Weighed & Measured Items Sell products by kg, litre, metre, yard or gaz, with quantities like 1.5. Free, off by default. Products already using a unit keep selling while off. Not offered in the WhatsApp chatbot. Expiry Date Tracking Record expiry dates on stock. The batch closest to expiry sells first, its price and cost follow that batch, and expired stock can no longer be sold. Free, off by default. While off, stock sells oldest first and any dates are ignored. Social Posting Plan Post products to the shop's own Facebook Page and Instagram, and run Meta ads. Off by default.
